strips.hook: [device: euphemism-unmasked] [target: corporate euphemism | form: two-hander | aim: systemic | mechanic: etymological-unmasking (#14) | cast: Cal + Milo (Milo debut)] A new SDR asks why his prospect's VP is suddenly CC'd on his follow-up. Cal says 'for visibility' — and it turns out to be literally accurate: the VP can't help, only watch. Cal's rule for the move (one per deal, spent when the deal is already dead) reveals he wrote Milo's deal off this morning. Radar seed: scout Source 1 (SaaStr AI SDRs — 3,221 emails/mo vs 75-285, reply rates flat) + Techmeme (Apple caps bug-report submissions over an AI-assisted deluge) => volume never applies pressure; the CC to someone's boss is how humans actually do it. News-deleted, the strip is unchanged.
strips.caption:
"Adding Priya for visibility."

Everyone in B2B knows exactly what that sentence means. Nobody has ever written down what it means.

strips.hook: [device: ritual-as-agency] [target: the protagonists' own failings | form: three-hander (rotating witness) | aim: inward | mechanic: anti-work-equilibrium | cast: Milo+Cal+Susie] You refresh the inbox that would have pinged you anyway — not for the reply, for the one thing at work that responds the second you ask.
strips.caption:
You know it notifies you. You refresh anyway.

Somewhere between hitting send and hearing back, the refresh stops being about the reply. What's your number today?

strips.hook: Focus time: fiercely defended at the door, personally squandered — confessed behavior. Loop round 2 under the 16-eval battery (V8 active).
strips.caption: 2:00–4:00 PM. Do not disturb.

strips.hook: The proposal tracker that watches you re-read your own email — confessed self-open behavior, authored via the eval loop (S-series 28/30 unanimous).
strips.caption: The tracker doesn't lie.
